hero.title: Exclusive Custom Porcelain
hero.description: Ganka for Home is an elegant tableware created by a craftswoman not only within the scope of her own creative ideas and vision. Ganka also makes collaborative collections that reflect the client's plans. She gives ideas an interesting form, and they go on to have their own life.

customOrder.title: Make an Exclusive Order
customOrder.description: You can order a consultation and create your own individual plate or collection of porcelain tableware together with the artist. Each element reflects Ganka's love for detail, her ability to transform everyday things into something special. Her works are an exquisite balance between form and color, embodying joy, tenderness, and kindness.

image.alt: Exclusive cat illustration on porcelain plate

data.title: Summer Citronelle Collection
data.paragraphs:
In collaboration with the restaurant Citronelle, Ganka created a series of exclusive porcelain collections designed to complement its extraordinary interior.

These artistic plates enhance the dining experience, allowing guests to enjoy each dish with an added sense of beauty and individuality.

Selected pieces are also available for collectors who wish to bring this refined restaurant atmosphere into their own homes.

image.alt: Summer Citronelle tea set and plate

data.title: Four-Leaf Collection
data.paragraphs:
Limited edition created for Empire Hall. The collection was born at a time when you especially want to believe in good signs

In simple, almost unnoticed symbols that can become special if you look at them more closely.

We are always looking for signs of fate, hoping for positive changes, but true luck is having the chance to share happy moments with those around you.

data.title: Horses Collection
data.paragraphs:
Ganka works on projects not only for corporate clients.

 Each of us can try to create our own individual plate, candle, or even a collection made up of different items. One example of this kind of individual collaboration is the «Horses» collection.

image.alt: Exclusive horse portrait painted on plate
